info.title: MarineTraffic API
info.description:
Vessel and port data from MarineTraffic: search vessels by name, IMO or MMSI; vessel particulars; latest AIS position and voyage (destination, ETA); port search and details; and the ships in or near a port.

Every request needs an API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys. A successful request uses one credit, unless its operation says more (`x-credits`). That price covers 200 rows (or the operation's `x-credits-rows`); a request that returns more pays it again for each further page of that many rows. The `x-maviapi-credits` response header says what a request cost. A query param an operation does not take is ignored and named in the `x-maviapi-unknown-params` response header; send the `x-maviapi-strict: 1` request header to have such a request refused with a free `400 unknown_param` instead.

Endpoint reference with live examples: https://maviapi.com/apis/marinetraffic

get.description:
Ports, anchorages and offshore terminals whose name or UN/LOCODE matches the text, in the site's relevance order (the site returns at most about 12 matches). Each row has the port id, name, type, country, UN/LOCODE, coordinates, size and the name or code it matched on.

Each successful request uses 5 credits.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: port name (at least 3 characters) or UN/LOCODE, e.g. "rotterdam" or "NLRTM"

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the page starts (default 0).

get.description:
Ships currently in or near a port: every identified vessel the live map shows within radius_km of the port's position (anonymous [SAT-AIS] placeholders left out), nearest first, with position, distance, speed, course, heading, AIS destination, size, deadweight and the age of the position. `complete` is false only if part of the area could not be read; `map_requests` is how many map tiles were read.

Each successful request uses 5 credits.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: UN/LOCODE (e.g. NLRTM) or MarineTraffic port id

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: search radius around the port position, 0.5 to 15 km

parameters.name: vessel_type
parameters.description: only vessels of this map category (cargo, tanker, passenger, fishing, tug_special, high_speed, pleasure, navigation_aid, unspecified)

parameters.name: moving
parameters.description: true for only vessels moving at 1 knot or more, false for only vessels stopped or moored

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the page starts (default 0).

get.description:
From free text to the live picture. kind=vessel: resolves an IMO, MMSI or exact vessel name and returns the vessel's details (`vessel`) and latest position with voyage (`position`). kind=port: resolves a UN/LOCODE or exact port name and returns the port's details (`port`) and the nearest vessels within 5 km (`vessels`, nearest first). `resolved` says what the text was resolved to. A name matching several vessels or ports is refused as ambiguous, with the candidates listed in the error.

Each successful request uses 5 credits.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: vessel name, IMO or MMSI (kind=vessel), or port name or UN/LOCODE (kind=port)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: what to resolve the text to: vessel or port

parameters.name: nearby
parameters.description: kind=port: how many nearby vessels to include (0 to 50)

get.description:
Latest AIS position of one vessel (latitude/longitude, speed in knots, course, heading, rate of turn, draught, navigational status, sea area, report time in UTC and its age, reception type) with its voyage: destination reported over AIS, ETA, progress, departure port and time, arrival port and time (actual once arrived, else estimated).

Each successful request uses 5 credits.

maviapiKey.description: Your maviapi API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys.

Fields.name: fields
Fields.description: Row fields to keep in a list answer, comma separated (at most 50). A dot reaches into an object, or into each object of an array (venue.city). A name no row has is a 400 that lists the fields a row has.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: pagination.next_cursor of the previous page, sent with the same other params: the next page of the same stored copy of the list, so a walk never skips or repeats a row when the cache refreshes or the site reorders. A cursor for other params is 400 invalid_cursor; a copy that is gone is 410 cursor_expired (start again without cursor).

MaxAge.name: max_age
MaxAge.description: Serve a stored answer only when it was read at most this many seconds ago (0 to 86400); older, the site is read again. 0 is refresh=true. Any other value is 400 invalid_max_age.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

retryable.description: Whether the same request may succeed later without any change. When true, wait the seconds in `Retry-After` (if sent) first.

FetchedAt.description: When this data was read from the site (ISO 8601, UTC). Also in the x-maviapi-fetched-at header.

Age.description: Seconds since fetched_at: 0 for a fresh read, more for a stored answer. Also in the Age header.

NextCursor.description: Send as `cursor`, with the same other params, for the next page of the same copy of the list; null on the last page.

BadRequest.description: A parameter is missing or cannot be used (`bad_request`), or, with the `x-maviapi-strict: 1` request header, a query param the operation does not take was sent (`unknown_param`, with the names in `params`).

Unauthorized.description: No API key was sent, or the key is invalid or revoked (`missing_api_key`, `invalid_api_key`).

example.message: Provide an API key via the Authorization: Bearer <key> header.

CreditLimitReached.description: The plan's credits for this period are used up.

example.message: You've used all 1,000 credits in your Free plan for this period. Upgrade your plan for a higher allotment.

AccountSuspended.description: The account that owns the key is suspended.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this key (`rate_limited`), or too many at once for its plan (`concurrency_limited`). Wait the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

example.message: Rate limit exceeded for this API key (600 requests a minute).

UpstreamFailed.description: The source site could not be read this time. Retrying later usually works.

example.message: The upstream source could not be fetched

CursorExpired.description: The stored copy of the list this cursor walks is gone. Start the list again without cursor.

example.message: The copy of the list this cursor walks is gone. Start the list again without cursor.
